source.locator: Theorem 5.1 and the minimax-optimality paragraph immediately following it

attestation.note: Transcribed and specialized from the primary-source TeX of Theorem 5.1 and the paragraph immediately following it. The cited leaf concerns the bounded-reward source model; the Gaussian transfer is derived in this solve's feasibility proof.

proposed_statement_changes.reason: The frozen lower bound is false at the permitted boundary \(\Delta_0=2M\). For the admissible balanced benchmark \(\pi_0\equiv1/2\), bounded means and \(|\tau_P|\geq2M\) force \(|\tau_P|=2M\), hence \(\theta(P)=M\) for every law and the deterministic interval \([M,M]\) has zero width whenever a feasible design exists. The proposed interior condition is exactly what permits a constant-gap law and a same-class perturbation of only its inferior arm; it restricts the parameter regime and does not assume the testing conclusion.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Declare the published two-arm minimax-regret result used as the bounded-reward substrate; the Gaussian transfer itself is proved locally.

proposed.justification: This cited sanity reduction marks the empty-design regime before any honest-width branch is considered.
proposed.gap: PerchetRigollet2013CovariateBandits gives the two-arm Hölder--margin minimax regret order in its bounded-reward model. The present proof derives the fixed-scale Gaussian concentration replacement and separately handles the vacuous-margin case \(\alpha=0\).
proposed.consumer: The supporting lemma retains the \(\rho=T^{3/5}\) early-kill threshold and prevents a width formula from being asserted in an infeasible regime.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The narrowed claim explicitly names the margin-interior condition, so its free-symbol metadata must include the constants occurring in that condition.

proposed.justification: This theorem isolates the compulsory \(\rho^{-1/2}\) obstruction and verifies that benchmark cancellation cannot remove it in every nondegenerate fixed-gap class.
proposed.gap: The boundary \(\Delta_0=2M\) can make the target known exactly. The strict interior condition is necessary for the same-class inferior-arm perturbation used by the honest-length converse.
proposed.consumer: Trialists using a conventional benchmark obtain the exact price of protecting participants away from treatment ties and a design that pays no additional order penalty.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Prove right closedness and a uniform no-overshoot bound for the generalized inverse \(w_n\), and construct from the quotas an actual predictable design plus connected interval obeying random context-arrival capacities and the welfare budget.
open_obligations.obstruction: Fixed-\(w\) primal--dual value equality does not control discontinuities of \(w\mapsto\mathcal B(w)\). The frozen handle \(\mathsf H_{T,\rho}\) is descriptive prose: it specifies neither assignment kernels nor interval endpoints, and the allocation program has no stochastic cell-capacity or welfare-price constraint. Those missing maps and inequalities cannot be inferred from the definition.
open_obligations.attempted: Reduced every active-cell program to a two-dimensional zero-sum game, proved weak duality, derived equality of primal and measure-dual values through finite-dimensional convex separation, and analyzed the generalized inverse. This isolates the remaining step as continuity/jump control plus sequential quota realization, not duality.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Derive the Hölder-local honest-width branch and exhibit one welfare-budgeted adaptive design and connected interval attaining it uniformly over the full model class.
open_obligations.obstruction: The only frozen proposed attaining construction is not an estimator or design map, and the bump lemma proved here changes a high-gap inferior regression but does not populate the sign-reversing alternative sets used by the allocation program. Consequently neither a local modulus exponent nor its upper match follows from the current primitives. Claiming equivalence would assume the named bottleneck.
open_obligations.attempted: Established the exact feasibility exponent, the all-procedure coverage-to-information reduction, the corrected fixed-gap \(\rho^{-1/2}\) frontier, and an adaptive-KL bump family. Also checked the early-kill specialization and bounded the target diameter.
